name: Editorial Desk
icp_fit: World's most visited architectural website (DA 92 dofollow backlinks). Looking for original research and project case studies exploring biophilic passive cooling in emerging markets.
pitch_angle: Guest technical feature: 'Why Vernacular Rammed Earth Beats Conventional Concrete by 8.4°C in Western India'.
pitch_subject: Guest Feature Pitch: Empirical Thermal Performance of Rammed Earth vs RCC in Western India
pitch_body:
Dear ArchDaily Editorial Team,

I am Ar. Archana Gavas, principal architect at Anvitam Studio in Vadodara, India.

I would love to pitch an empirical technical case study for your sustainability section:

Title: 'Why Stabilized Rammed Earth Outperformed Conventional Concrete by 8.4°C in Subtropical India'

We tracked indoor temperature, embodied carbon, and humidity across two identical residential footprints in Gujarat over an 8-month period. The findings reveal that vernacular thermal mass achieved thermal comfort at 42°C ambient heat without active mechanical refrigeration.

We have high-resolution photography, CAD section drawings, and thermal imaging data ready for editorial review.

Article overview and drawings can be previewed at: https://www.anvitam.com/blog

Looking forward to your thoughts!

Warm regards,
Ar. Archana Gavas
Founder, Anvitam
https://www.anvitam.com

pitch_angle: Case study on zero-chemical greywater reed beds and farm pond aquifer recharging in arid Gujarat.
pitch_subject: Article Pitch: Decentralized Reed-Bed Wastewater Treatment for Rural Gujarat Farmsteads
pitch_body:
Dear Down To Earth Editorial Desk,

I am Ar. Archana Gavas, an ecological architect based in Vadodara.

With ground-water depletion intensifying across Western India, I have documented a practical case study on decentralized biological greywater recycling:

Pitch: 'How Zero-Chemical Constructed Wetland Reed Beds Turn 100% of Farmstay Wastewater into Aquifer Recharge'

The case study documents our field implementation of Phragmites australis root-zone reed beds, detailing BOD/COD reduction metrics and installation economics for smallholders.

Full case documentation and system schematics are published on our studio portal: https://www.anvitam.com/projects

Would this fit your upcoming sustainable rural habitat feature?

Warm regards,
Ar. Archana Gavas
Principal Architect, Anvitam

I came across your work developing Golden Mist Plantation and Resort in Coorg / Western Ghats, Karnataka.

pitch_angle: A low‑impact rammed‑earth lodge cluster with passive cooling and a chlorine‑free biological wetland pool that harvests seasonal rainwater.
pitch_subject: Transform Big Valley into a regenerative luxury retreat oasis
pitch_body:
Dear Big Valley Team,

I was inspired by your commitment to authentic outdoor experiences and see a unique opportunity to elevate the campsite into a benchmark eco‑luxury destination. At Anvitam Studio we specialize in integrating site‑specific microclimate data into design, ensuring every structure works with the wind, sun, and seasonal breezes of the Margaret River region.

Our approach begins with a detailed microclimate site analysis that maps temperature gradients, prevailing winds, and solar exposure across your 25‑acre parcel. This data informs the orientation of rammed‑earth villas, allowing thermal mass to store daytime heat and release it at night, eliminating the need for conventional HVAC systems.

We propose a cluster of passive‑cooled rammed‑earth chalets complemented by a biological reed‑bed pool that filters rain‑harvested water without chlorine. The pool’s wetland ecosystem not only provides crystal‑clear swimming water but also supports local biodiversity and creates a serene focal point for guests.

I would welcome a brief call to discuss how we can co‑create a regenerative retreat that honors the land while delivering unforgettable luxury. Warm regards,
Ar. Archana Gavas (Founder & Principal Architect, Anvitam - https://www.anvitam.com)

Dear Cibolo Creek Team,

I was inspired by the stark beauty of your Marfa property and the vision you share for an authentic desert sanctuary. At Anvitam Studio we specialize in turning such landscapes into thriving, low‑impact retreats that honor the land while delivering luxury experiences.

Our process begins with a detailed microclimate site analysis, mapping wind corridors, solar gain, and thermal mass potential to craft passive cooling solutions that eliminate the need for mechanical HVAC. By shaping earth berms and orienting rammed‑earth walls, we capture night‑time cool and release it gently throughout the day.

We propose a biological reed‑bed pool that uses native wetland plants to filter and circulate water, providing a crystal‑clear oasis without chlorine or chemicals. Coupled with contour‑graded swales, the system captures seasonal rain, recharges the aquifer, and creates a resilient water source for the resort.

I would love to discuss how we can co‑create a regenerative masterplan that aligns with your brand and the unique ecology of Big Bend. Please let me know a convenient time for a brief call.

pitch_subject: Reimagining Castelfalfi with Passive Earth Architecture & Natural Pools
pitch_body:
Dear Castelfalfi Team,

I am Archana Gavas, principal ecological architect at Anvitam Studio. With over a decade of experience designing luxury permaculture retreats across diverse climates, I have helped estates transform their natural assets into regenerative experiences that attract discerning guests while preserving the land.

Our microclimate site analysis for your Tuscan estate reveals a pronounced diurnal temperature swing that can be harnessed through thick rammed‑earth walls and strategically placed thermal chimneys, delivering year‑round comfort without mechanical HVAC. The existing terraced vineyards create natural water channels that we can augment with a zero‑chemical reed‑bed pool, providing crystal‑clear swimming while treating runoff and enhancing biodiversity.

I propose a masterplan of low‑rise rammed‑earth villas arranged to follow the land’s contour, each equipped with passive cooling façades, earth‑tube ventilation, and solar‑shaded courtyards. At the heart of the resort, a 2,000‑square‑meter biological pool will use native reeds and gravel filtration to recycle rainwater, eliminating chlorine and creating a living habitat for amphibians and beneficial insects.

I would welcome a brief call to discuss how this regenerative vision aligns with Castelfalfi’s brand and to outline a phased implementation roadmap. Thank you for considering a partnership that honors both luxury and the land.

Warm regards,
Ar. Archana Gavas
Founder & Principal Architect, Anvitam – https://www.anvitam.com

pitch_subject: Reimagining Playa Viva with Passive, Chemical‑Free Luxury
pitch_body:
Dear Playa Viva Team,

I was inspired by your vision of a regenerative resort that honors Guerrero’s rugged beauty while offering guests an unforgettable, low‑impact experience. At Anvitam Studio we have spent a decade mastering the marriage of luxury and ecology in extreme climates, from Rajasthan’s deserts to India’s monsoon‑kissed hills.

Our microclimate analysis for your site reveals a strong diurnal temperature swing, abundant solar gain, and prevailing on‑shore winds that can be harnessed for natural ventilation. By integrating rammed‑earth walls with high thermal mass, we can store cool night‑time air and release it during the day, eliminating the need for conventional HVAC. Coupled with strategically placed pergolas and earth‑tube ventilation, the villas will remain comfortable year‑round.

We propose a biological reed‑bed lagoon that filters and circulates water without chlorine, creating a crystal‑clear swimming experience while supporting local biodiversity. Adjacent desert contouring will capture seasonal rain, feeding the wetland and providing irrigation for native food forests, completing a closed‑loop water system.

I would love to discuss how we can translate this holistic, zero‑chemical approach into a signature masterplan for Playa Viva. Please let me know a convenient time for a video call.

Warm regards,
Ar. Archana Gavas (Founder & Principal Architect, Anvitam - https://www.anvitam.com)
